truth_boundary: Existing reader interfaces support the mission; ablation results, automatic theorem neighborhoods, new principles, model training and real-world safety validation remain research agenda items. Full local Lean gate did not run beyond dependency acquisition, so only an explicitly unverified preview was built. README.md and docs/math-2-0-positioning.md accompany this bounded publication change but are outside the checker's protected-production affected_files set.
